title: Article 46 — Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections

content.overview: Article 46 directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and in particular of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and to protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
content.glance: Special care for educational and economic interests of weaker sections, especially SCs and STs; protect from social injustice and exploitation.
content.study:
Article 46 supports protective discrimination and welfare measures for SCs, STs and other weaker sections. It is often read with Articles 15(4)–(5), 16(4) and related reservation and welfare provisions.

Examination: special care; educational and economic interests; SCs and STs in particular; protection from injustice and exploitation.
